title: Expectation and scalar division
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $c\in\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of the function $x\mapsto f(x)/c$ under $p$ equals the expectation of $f$ divided by $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
